    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = next(((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1), None)
    two = next(((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2), None)
    if one is None or two is None:
        return out
    r, c = one
    tr, tc = two
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1 if tr < r else 0
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1 if tc < c else 0
    nr, nc = abs(tr-r), abs(tc-c)
    diagonal_steps = max(0, min(nr, nc) - 1)
    for _ in range(diagonal_steps):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    remaining = max(nr, nc) - diagonal_steps - 1
    for _ in range(max(0, remaining)):
        if nr > nc:
            r += dr
        elif nc > nr:
            c += dc
        else:
            break
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
